title: AUTHORIZING the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) or their designee to execute an amendment to the Joint Development Agreement (JDA) with Chavez Fickett, L.P.…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0407, Agreement]
[PLANNING AND PROGRAMMING COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (4-0):]
AUTHORIZING the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) or their  designee to execute an amendment to the Joint Development Agreement (JDA) with Chavez Fickett, L.P. (Developer), an affiliate of Abode Communities, to extend the term for one year, from October 19, 2026 to October 19, 2027, with an option to extend for one additional year for the joint development of a mixed-use, affordable housing project on 1.56 acres of Metro-owned property located at the corner of Cesar E. Chavez Avenue and Fickett Street in Boyle Heights (Project).
summary: Extends joint development agreement with Chavez Fickett, L.P./Abode Communities for mixed-use affordable housing project on Metro-owned property at Cesar E. Chavez Avenue and Fickett Street in Boyle Heights through October 2027.

locations.text: Cesar E. Chavez Avenue & Fickett Street, Los Angeles, CA

flag.reason: Keeps an affordable-housing project on Metro-owned land in Boyle Heights moving.
